svg.title: Architecture 3: Conv-BiGRU with origin state conditioning
svg.desc: Two convolution widths · FiLM conditioning · Two bidirectional GRU layers · 7 training epochs

g.text: Architecture 3: Conv-BiGRU with origin state conditioning
Two convolution widths · FiLM conditioning · Two bidirectional GRU layers · 7 training epochs
1. Origin state encoder and FiLM parameters
• Latest published spread and regulation direction
• Up-regulation share and spread variation over 8 steps
• Latest mFRR activation in each direction
FiLM parameters and GRU initial state
Scales convolution features by a factor from 0.5 to 1.5
Four states: two layers × two directions
Move the time axis last for Conv1d
Modulation formula: c_mod = γ ⊙ c + β
• Convolutions extract patterns in known covariates
• FiLM lets the same pattern be treated differently
Concatenate conditioned features and origin state:
• Initial state h0 comes from the origin encoder
• The forward pass reads earlier delivery steps
• The backward pass reads later known covariates
The GRU combines both directions at each delivery step
Retain the convolution features alongside the GRU output
Combines local patterns and horizon context
Ordered by construction: q_05 ≤ … ≤ q_50 ≤ … ≤ q_95
Quantile loss: 0.45 × grid pinball + 0.35 × MAE + 0.20 × tail pinball
Inference averages the classifier and quantile CDF estimates
Shapes: origin → FiLM and h0; X_step [B,40,30] → convolutions [B,40,96] → FiLM → BiGRU [B,40,96] → residual fusion [B,40,128] → output heads
